caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular grandfather clock with a wooden case in shades of brown. The clock has a broad base with a smooth texture and is supported by four small, gold-colored feet. The upper part of the clock features a glass-encased clock face that is rounded at the top and flat at the bottom, displaying black Arabic numerals from 1 to 12 and two clock hands. The area around the clock face shows subtle floral patterns, and the name "E. Willard" is written in the lower section of the clock face. Above the main body, the clock's top section includes an ornate, decorative finial in the center and smaller pinnacles on each corner. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details.
title: Shelf Clock
